name: Menia
source:
The Demon Emperor Surtr's assistant who supports him in dealing with internal affairs.

A cool-headed secretary who carries out the Demon Emperor's orders with efficiency.

Although she is Fena's sister, they have a very stormy relationship and barely interact with each other.

「I am His Majesty's shield. Know that as long as I stand, no blade shall ever reach His Majesty.」

Weapon name: Niflheim
